patch.sql:
select
    distinct
    l_orderkey || '-' || l_linenumber as order_line_id,
    l_orderkey as order_key,
    l_linenumber as line_number,
    l_partkey as part_key,
    l_suppkey as supplier_key,
    l_quantity as quantity,
    l_extendedprice as extended_price,
    l_discount as discount,
    l_tax as tax,
    l_returnflag as return_flag,
    l_shipdate as ship_date,
    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as net_revenue
from {{ source('raw', 'lineitem') }}
patch.explanation: Added DISTINCT to the SELECT list to drop exact duplicate rows from the raw.lineitem source. The duplicates were identical across all columns, so removing them does not lose any unique information and resolves the unique_stg_lineitem_order_line_id check failure. Column names and types remain unchanged.
